name: base_extract_media
notes: Traced C copy of base_ext2.c::gw_extract_media vs LIVE gateway/platforms/base.py::extract_media (media-list rung). KNOWN DIVERGENCES documented in harness.c header: LIVE dedupes expanded paths, masks protected spans (code blocks / JSON strings) before scanning, and gates is_voice on audio extensions — the simplified C port does none of these. Inputs are curated to the agreeing subset: distinct unmasked media-extension paths; [[audio_as_voice]] inputs contain exactly one audio entry. Duplicate-path, code-wrapped, and voice+non-audio inputs are excluded because C/LIVE provably diverge there.
